name: Bamboo-tube fish
summary: Cá ống tre is fish cooked in a bamboo tube. A 2012 feature names it at Ban Ang in the same sentence as love sticky rice and leaf-yeast wine. A fuller method was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Ban Ang. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism, 26 September 2012.
howToEat: Eat it from the tube at a village meal. A fuller method is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43.
